name: Special Meeting and Adjournment Memo Revised
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: January 28, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting and Adjournment of Regular Meeting
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The regularly scheduled City Council Meeting on Monday, February 2, 2026, is adjourned. In its stead, the City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Monday, February 2, 2026, during the following times.
The Council will convene at 10:00 a.m. in Open Session to hear the following items:
Proclamations: Assistant Chief Tina Williams Day
Commander Matt Novak Day
Deputy Chief Rudy Tai Day
Public comment on Closed Session items
The Council will then recess into Closed Session and reconvene at 2:00 p.m. to hear the following:
Consent agenda items: First Amendment to Extend Contract with Lexipol LLC
Ordinance Approving Contract with NEOGOV for Applicant Recruitment, Tracking, and Hiring Software (RFP 10091078-25-O)
Authorize the Stormwater Department to accept and appropriate funding from the California Department of Housing and Community Development 2024 Disaster Recovery Infrastructure and Mitigation Planning Program (DR-Infrastructure and MIT-RIPP)
Reappointment to the Horton Plaza Theatres Foundation
Appointment to the San Diego Convention Center Corporation, Inc., Board of Directors
Discussion agenda items: Performance Audit of Fire-Rescue Overtime
Resolution of the Council of the City of San Diego in Opposition to Unnecessarily Aggressive and Excessive Tactics used by Federal Immigration Enforcement Authorities Throughout the United States and in Support of Litigation Seeking to Curb and Prevent these Atrocious Actions
Non-agenda public comment
The City Council will resume its regular order of business on Monday, February 9, 2026, at 10:00am at City Council Chambers.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
